The Approximate Number Generation chart has three slices: Comparative Relationships (36.26%, blue), Approximate Quantities (45.03%, yellow), and Absolute Absence (18.71%, purple). The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart is split into two slices: Disjunctive (49.51%, light purple) and Conjunctive (50.49%, light pink).
